visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Separate the Arithmetic
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Four almost identical if blocks each do their own stack bookkeeping. Move the arithmetic into an apply function so the loop pushes one result. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The arithmetic lives in one small function, so the loop only manages the stack. A new operator is one more case in the switch instead of another copy of the stack bookkeeping.
